scope: Event minimal experiment only; this verdict does not represent the full host
decision: The event-native layout, hierarchy, responsiveness and business interactions pass, but the approved contained identity-media requirement does not. The large navy region is an empty decorative block rather than identity-bearing event media, so the experiment cannot be signed off yet.

blockingFindings.evidence: All three fresh screenshots show a blank navy/gradient identity zone: top 126px at 390 and the right ~40% of the event header at 536/1280. It contains no event artwork, event mark or content-bearing host media.
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Populate the already-contained rectangular zone with appropriate existing Pokémon event media or a host-native event identity composition, preserving the current title/status/metrics and avoiding a full-screen character poster. Re-run fresh QA with art and explicit hues masked.

advisories.evidence: The hidden/framework taro-navigation-bar-loading node still reports a 2s infinite loading animation under prefers-reduced-motion. No experiment content animation remains and no visible motion was observed.
advisories.recommendation: Suppress this framework loading animation under reduced motion when the shared shell is next maintained.

surfaceAndMass.evidence: Warm map-paper and warm-white content surfaces dominate every viewport; dark navy is bounded to the event header media zone rather than used as a global application surface.

identityMedia.evidence: The correct contained rectangle exists, but it is visually empty and therefore does not perform the required event identity/media function.

contentIntegrity.evidence: The complete title 宝可梦总冠军赛 2026, 进行中 state, date, format, 128-player and 128-deck metrics are visible at 390, 536 and 1280.

informationHierarchy.evidence: The order is identity/title/status, ruled metrics, 赛程, first round, top deck and 查看全部卡组. CJK title and labels are legible with no visible truncation.

geometryAndColorRoles.evidence: Cards/actions use low-radius rectangles and thin rules. Red is limited to archive/round/action markers, yellow to the rank marker, navy to structure, and semantic green to live status. No dominant pill controls appear.

firstScreenBudget.evidence: At all three fixed viewports the event header completes above the fold and the first schedule, top-deck row and round action begin inside the first viewport.

maskedStructuralRecognition.evidence: After ignoring character/card art, explicit colors and brand names, composition remains recognizable through paper mass, split identity card geometry, ruled metrics, editorial schedule heading and rectangular islands. The blank media panel remains a separate blocker.

interactionParity.evidence: Round action and top-deck action each navigate correctly by pointer, Enter and Space. Each has role=button, tabindex=0, returns to the same Event URL on Back and remains stable after reload.

runtimeAndBusinessSafety.evidence: All three renders report 0px document overflow. No non-GET request occurred during rendering, navigation, Back or reload. No visible clipping was found; the title probe's subpixel scroll/client rounding is not visible truncation.

otherRoutes.evidence: Plaza, Build, Mine, Round and Detail 390px screenshots are byte-identical to Attempt 10/baseline hashes and each reports 0px overflow.
